title: Joomla new site: the quickstart's Super User ("Tracy Agent") takes the business name as display name, so bylines and author pages no longer say Tracy Agent
steps: S1: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/brief-brand-joomla-author.test.mjs (setSiteBrand on a fake Joomla site with Super User 42 'Tracy Agent', a sample author in group 2 and a Tracy Access account in group 8)
expect: S1: user 42 is renamed to the given name, or to the site name when none is given; the sample author and the Tracy Access account keep their names; only the name column is written under the brand apply id and apply.revert restores 'Tracy Agent'

selectors.engine: brief-engines/brand-joomla-author.js writeDemoAuthorName, called from brand-joomla.js writeJoomlaBrand

evidence: iMac DDEV tracy-ja-boxing-j6 (plugin 0.24.61), 25/10/2026: users 42/52 renamed through the plugin door, meta author 'JA Boxing' rendered, reverted
fence: The demo Super User's display name follows the business; no other account is touched

tests: a name the customer gave becomes the demo Super User display name, and only that
no name given: the demo Super User takes the site name as it stands
